updates.content:
Title: Some admins' Microsoft 365 admin center usage report data may be delayed

User impact: Admins' Microsoft 365 admin center usage report data may be delayed.

More info: Specifically, Microsoft 365 admin center usage reports include the following:
 
- Microsoft 365 Copilot Readiness Reports may be delayed for admins in North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and the latest data is from August 31, 2026.
- Copilot Chat Reports may be delayed for admins in North America and the latest data is from September 3, 2026.
- Microsoft 365 Apps usage Reports may be delayed for admins in North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and the latest data is from August 31, 2026.
- Microsoft Teams User Activity Reports may be delayed for admins in North America, Asia Pacific, and the latest data is from is from September 1, 2026.

Current status: We've been made aware of an issue in which some admins' Microsoft 365 admin center usage report data may be delayed. We've identified that an upstream data source pipeline issue is causing delays in some usage report data availability and is resulting in impact. We've developed a solution and are applying it to the affected pipeline to address the issue. We anticipate that impact to Copilot chat report data will be resolved by Sunday, September 6, 2026, at 3:30 AM UTC, and in the interim, we're working on determining the timeline for resolution for the remaining affected reports, which we aim to provide by our next scheduled communications update.

Scope of impact: Admins attempting to view some usage report data in the Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An upstream data source pipeline issue is causing delays in some usage report data availability and is resulting in impact.

Next update by: Monday, September 7, 2026, at 1:00 AM UTC
